environment.ids: STARLING_S1_DUMP_IDS unique writable path per process; pull raw little-endian int32 after every request before overwrite
environment.phone: unplugged/discharging, display OFF, thermal<2, battery<42C, Spotify user-paused; no app/settings changes

fixtures_source: fixtures.json from the pinned kit; input text exact and no styling/context

parity_preflight.per_case: one untimed same-case warmup then one diagnostic request; save text and int32 ID bytes immediately
parity_preflight.gate: Each copy diagnostic output and raw int32 ID sequence must equal same-device greedy for the same case. Stop before measured latency blocks on any mismatch. No host hash parity gate.

performance.generic_startup_warmup: --warmup before the untimed same-case warmups and all measured requests
performance.same_case_warmup: one short and one medium untimed request before measured requests, each ID dump saved
performance.latency: Host-monotonic POST /normalize wall from request send to complete response for measured requests only, excluding subsequent diagnostic ID pull. Pair each with its own S1_TIMING total from native stderr, copy counters, and token count; report transport/dispatch gap descriptively. Same ADB forwarding, model, threads, and inputs across arms.
performance.load: record process launch to health ready including generic startup warmup and internal model load stage separately; exclude both load and all warmups from measured request latency
performance.parity_gate: Every measured greedy AND copy output and raw int32 ID sequence must equal the same-device preflight greedy reference for that case; stop directional claims on any mismatch or missing dump. Every native S1_TIMING line must parse: greedy copy=0,max_k=0; copy copy=1,max_k=2. Record accepted/proposed/verify/fallback counters for each measured copy request; zero proposals are reported explicitly, not assumed useful.
performance.request_scope: One server per block; process launch to /health ready (including generic startup warmup) recorded separately. One untimed same-case warmup for short and medium before measured requests. Four measured requests in fixed short, medium, short, medium order; pull raw ID dump after each request before next, outside the timed request interval.
performance.battery: Charge counter has shown >110s stale plateaus in the preceding quant pilot. Record unplugged/screen/temperature/thermal state before and after each block for validity, but do not calculate or claim an energy contrast; no idle-bracket drain campaign.
performance.cooldown: At least 30s between processes. Thermal>=2, battery>=42C, screen ON, or charging abort the block. Before each block prefer thermal<2 and battery<37C; wait up to180s to cool. If still 37–41.9C with thermal<2, run only descriptively and disable directional latency claim.
performance.directional_latency_rule: For EACH fixture (short and medium) and EACH metric (host HTTP wall and native S1_TIMING total) separately, report the two within-block medians and both adjacent greedy-minus-copy contrasts (blocks1–2 and4–3). An exploratory positive direction for that fixture/metric requires exact ID/text parity in all blocks, valid native mode fields, no cooldown breach, and both adjacent contrasts >0. Do not infer native speedup from host sign, pool fixtures silently, or claim a confidence interval or release gate.

protected_k4_smoke.scope: exact same-device text and int32 ID parity plus required ZX-1042 and https://example.org/manual spans; no performance or energy claim
